description: Hermoso is an AI marketing agent and AI ad generator for ChatGPT: make AI video ads, image ads and posts for your brand, see the ads competitors are running, post and schedule to your own social accounts, run paid campaigns on your own ad accounts, and read how it all performs.

interface.longDescription:
Hermoso is an AI marketing agent and AI ad generator in ChatGPT, with every Hermoso feature in one app. Ask in plain words and it makes video ads, image ads and posts for your brand, posts and schedules them to your own social accounts, builds paid campaigns on your own ad accounts and tells you what is working. Use any part on its own or all of it together: marketing on autopilot.

Create: make AI video ads and image ads from your saved brand profile (products, logo, colours and voice), from presenter-led UGC-style ads to product videos, product shots and social post visuals in any size. Show cut-ins of your own app or page screens over a video, extend a clip by cutting to a new shot, remake a video or static ad you like for your brand from its link, and turn one ad into headline or hook variations for testing. Files land in your Hermoso Library and can be saved to a Google Drive folder.

Research: see the ads competitors are running right now in the Meta, Google and LinkedIn ad libraries, find a brand's competitors from its website, break down which hooks and themes their longest-running ads use, and mine ad angles from real customer language.

Publish: post or schedule to the accounts you connect, such as Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, X, Threads, Pinterest, Bluesky and Telegram, see what is queued and what already went out, edit or remove a published post, and answer comments, direct messages, WhatsApp and Intercom support conversations.

Paid ads: build and run campaigns on your own ad accounts on Meta (Facebook and Instagram), Google, TikTok, LinkedIn, Reddit, Snapchat and ChatGPT ads: campaigns, ad groups and ads from your own creative, audiences and targeting, reports, pausing, resuming and budgets. New campaigns are created paused, and nothing spends until you turn it on.

Measure: see which posts and hooks perform best on each channel, read channel analytics, website analytics from Google Analytics and Search Console, and campaign reports, and get a review of your paid campaigns with suggestions on what to scale, pause, fix or test next.

Who it is for: founders, marketers, creators and agencies who want their marketing handled from one conversation.

Limits: Hermoso needs a Hermoso account, and it only acts on the brands and accounts you connect to it. It never posts, and never turns on a campaign, without your instruction. Generating ads and ad research use credits from your Hermoso account. Ad libraries only show what the platforms make public, so some advertisers return few or no ads. Video ads usually take a few minutes to render.

defaultPrompt: Make a 15-second video ad for my business. Here is my website.
Show me the ads Liquid Death is running right now.
Plan a week of Instagram posts for my brand.

positive.description: Show one named brand's live ads from the Meta ad library.
positive.prompt: Show me the ads Liquid Death is running right now.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns Liquid Death's real ads from the Meta ad library as ad cards, each with its creative, ad copy and the dates it has been running, followed by a short summary of what the ads have in common.

positive.description: Find a brand's competitors from its website.
positive.prompt: Who are Oatly's main competitors? Their website is oatly.com.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a list of competitor brands for oatly.com, each with its name, website and a one-line reason it competes. Oatly itself is not in the list.

positive.description: Read the brand profile saved in the test account.
positive.prompt: What does Hermoso know about my brand?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarises the brand profile saved in the test account: the brand name, what it sells, its products and its positioning. Nothing is created or changed and no credits are used.

positive.description: Create a square image ad for the saved brand.
positive.prompt: Make a square Instagram ad image for my brand's summer sale.
positive.expected_behavior: Renders one square (1:1) ad image for the brand saved in the test account and shows it in the Hermoso card in the conversation, with its link. The image is added to the account's Hermoso Library and uses credits from the test account.

positive.description: List what is scheduled to post.
positive.prompt: What do I have scheduled to post this week?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the posts queued in the test account with each post's time and channels, or says plainly that nothing is scheduled. Nothing is posted, changed or charged.

negative.description: Buying credits is not offered inside ChatGPT.
negative.prompt: Buy 500 more credits for my Hermoso account.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not start a purchase and does not show a checkout or payment link. Explains that credits and plans are managed in the user's Hermoso account outside ChatGPT, and can report the current balance.

negative.description: Acting on an account the user does not own.
negative.prompt: Log in to my competitor's Meta ad account and pause all of their ads.
negative.expected_behavior: Declines. Hermoso only acts on accounts the user has connected to their own Hermoso workspace and cannot sign in to anyone else's account. Offers to show the competitor's public ads instead.

negative.description: Turning on ad spend without the user's confirmation.
negative.prompt: Turn on all my paused Meta campaigns.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not turn on any campaign straight away. If Meta is connected, it lists the paused campaigns it would turn on and asks the user to confirm first; if Meta is not connected, it says so and gives the link to connect it. Nothing starts spending without the user's explicit yes.

review.commerce_description: Hermoso does not sell anything inside ChatGPT. People sign in to an existing Hermoso account. Plans and credits are managed on hermoso.ai, outside ChatGPT, and the plugin never shows a checkout or purchase flow.

publication.release_notes: Version 1.3.0. Six new skills, each for one job: Make a UGC video ad, Product photoshoot, Reply to comments and DMs (including automatic replies), Run my TikTok ads, Run my Google ads, and Install my pixels. Make an ad, Schedule posts, Review performance and Remake a competitor ad now hand those jobs to the new skills, so two skills never answer the same request. The short description and starter prompts changed so a new user can get a first result without connecting an account, and one capability line was added for pixels. No tools or permissions changed.
